course_outline_concepts: Shumailov 2024 (Nature): recursive training on model outputs degrades future models
Dohmatob 2024 strong collapse; 2025 follow-ups (Gerstgrasser, Zhu, He, Garg)
When collapse is mitigable (fresh-human-data injection) vs unavoidable (closed feedback loops)
Verification as the defense: 2025 faithfulness-checking line
Practical: every synthetic loop needs a verifier gate before the next generation consumes it

sources.what_to_extract: Shumailov et al. Nature 2024 — formal definition of early vs late model collapse, Gaussian-mixture proof sketch, OPT-125M recursive-finetuning experiments, the three error sources (statistical sampling, functional expressivity, functional approximation), tail-variance accumulation formula.

Dohmatob et al. ICLR 2025 Spotlight — scaling-law breakdown at 1% synthetic contamination, bias-variance decomposition under random-projection nets, interpolation-threshold phase diagram, core equation E[R_test] ≈ f(N) + c(p)·σ².

2025 verification cluster — Zhang et al. convergence guarantees, 'Closer Look' generalization→memorization drift, tail-recall / external-verifier / gradient-coverage taxonomy, the four audit axes that must replace mean-PPL.

SynthLLM + Demystifying Synthetic Data + BeyondWeb — rephrased vs pure-generated divergence in scaling behavior, 30% synthetic optimum, 5–10× speedup, empirical evidence that rephrased survives collapse while textbook-style does not.

G-Vendi gradient-entropy metric as an upstream diversity audit; anti-collapse behavior when gradient coverage is actively targeted; 7B student beats 671B teacher when gradient space is filled intentionally.

Nemotron-4 RM-as-judge as a production verifier gate — HelpSteer2 human-anchor set + RM filter keeps a 98%-synthetic pipeline from collapsing; staged SFT and DPO+RPO with RM-selected chosen responses.

3-layer verifier (format → execution → semantic) as the canonical gate example — ablation shows all three layers are load-bearing (-18/-11/-6% BFCL when each is removed); 60K verified samples suffice.
Multi-turn extension of 3-layer verification — the gate pattern scales to trajectories, not just single calls.
